## Checklist

- [ ] I kept this PR focused on the stated change.
- [ ] I did not add private, leaked, or improperly obtained personal data.
- [ ] New ranking logic is deterministic and documented.
- [ ] AI-generated claims are grounded in public evidence before affecting official data.
- [ ] New data sources preserve provenance and retrieval timestamps.
- [ ] Methodology changes are versioned rather than silently replacing published logic.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behavior or methodology changed.
